name: Medicine shortages
value: UK SSPs in force; US chemo supply hit
summary: UK Serious Shortage Protocols run into January; flooded Pfizer plant may prolong US chemo shortages to 2028
state: NHSBSA's list checked on 17 Nov shows active Serious Shortage Protocols for lansoprazole orodispersible tablets to 15 Jan 2027, and for Estradot patches and Creon 25000 capsules to 8 Jan 2027, with none issued in November (NHSBSA). A Pfizer joint-venture plant in India closed by floods in July may not resume supply until 2028, prolonging shortages of cytarabine, irinotecan and bleomycin (CancerNetwork, 2 Nov). No widespread rationing was found.
for_you: If a usual medicine is unavailable, a UK pharmacist may supply an alternative under a Serious Shortage Protocol. NHS guidance advises not to stop a medicine without speaking to a pharmacist or GP.
rubric_hit: Watch: UK Serious Shortage Protocols in force for widely used medicines (NHSBSA, to Jan 2027)
basis_detail: FDA, EMA and NHSBSA shortage lists
basis_by: FDA, EMA and NHSBSA shortage lists

sources.title: Flood-damaged plant may prolong US chemotherapy shortages to 2028

why: Shipping disruption, factory failures and export curbs can leave essential medicines short, as with US IV fluids after Hurricane Helene in 2024.
drivers: Manufacturing concentrated in India and China, shipping, raw materials, demand spikes, regulation.

rubric.alert: Shortages forcing widespread rationing or cancelled treatment across major health systems.
rubric.watch: A shortage of an essential medicine or supply across several countries, or a UK Serious Shortage Protocol for a widely used medicine.
rubric.normal: No widespread shortages of essential medicines in major health systems.
